info.name: Sukoon Trust Verification API
info.description:
Task 11B — Production-safe QA kit.

**Default run:** folder `Safe Regression` only.
**Never** run the full collection on production.

Set `run_destructive_tests=true` only on staging/local for Destructive, Rate Limit, Webhook Manual, Admin Session folders.

Collection Runner: delay **1500 ms** between requests (`request_delay_ms`).
Newman: `--delay-request 1500 --folder "Safe Regression"`.
